instruction.text: Match the description of the needs to the correct people.

a.sound: It is cold and Brian does not have a place to stay, he needs shelter.
Amy has not had lunch, she is hungry and needs food.
Milly is feeling cold without a coat, she needs clothes.

instruction.text: Listen to the situation and select what the person needs.

atoms.a: Jenny just got back from a long run and is very thirsty.

instruction.text: Listen to the situation and select what the person needs.

atoms.a: Elena has been playing in her room all day with her window closed.

instruction.text: Listen and select the correct image.

atoms.a: Darrell has more than enough jackets at home. He has decided to donate some to those in need of warmer clothes. Select the image of the person in need.
Amber and her family are cleaning out their food cupboards and decide to donate a large amount to the food bank. Select the image of the bowl that needs to be filled.

feedback.end: Some people have more than they need. You can give away what you don’t need anymore. It could still be useful to others.
